datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Sudan. The spatial classifications were compiled into geographic datasets representing different food insecurity scenarios for medium-term projections in 2022, with data aggregated by administrative boundaries and time periods.
